system.name: Helix
system.one_liner: a distributed LLM serving system that formulates inference over heterogeneous GPUs and networks as a max-flow problem to plan placement and scheduling

content.key_idea: A Coordinator plans model placement once and then schedules each new request onto a per-request pipeline across heterogeneous GPU node types, where each compute node executes its assigned layers through per-layer queues.
content.reading_order: Left to right: the Coordinator's internal planning pipeline (Profiler to Planner to Scheduler), then out into the cluster graph of colored compute-node types, zooming into one Compute Node's queue/layer chain on the right.

summary: This figure gives an overview of Helix, an LLM serving system for heterogeneous GPU clusters. On the left, a Coordinator container shows the control flow: a Profiler gathers Cluster Info for a Model Placement Planner, which runs once per cluster to decide model placement (Init Worker), while a Scheduler uses that placement plus incoming New Request and Worker Finished events to assign each request a per-request pipeline (Worker Exec). The middle panel shows the resulting cluster as a graph of heterogeneous compute nodes colored by GPU type (Type-1 yellow, Type-2 blue, Type-3 green), each hosting a stack of model-layer icons, connected to a small Coordinator node. The right panel zooms into one Compute Node, showing how a Request Tensor flows through alternating per-layer Queues and Layers (Queue 1/Layer 1/Queue 2/Layer 2/Queue 3/Layer 3) as it executes the layers assigned to that node. A bottom legend defines the node-type colors and the model-layer icon.
summary_zh: 该图展示 Helix 系统概览：协调器（Profiler、模型放置规划器、调度器）负责一次性模型放置与逐请求流水线调度，中间图展示按 GPU 类型着色的异构计算节点拓扑，右侧放大展示单个计算节点内按层排队执行的过程。
